text: strange speech, and of an hard language: Heb. deep of lips, and heavy of tongue, and so ver. 6

strange speech and of an hard language: Heb. deep of lip, and heavy language | surely had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee: Or, if I had sent thee etc. would they not have hearkened unto thee?
impudent and hard hearted: Heb. stiff of forehead, and hard of heart
bitterness: Heb. bitter | heat of my spirit: Heb. hot anger
a reprover: Heb. a man reproving
